local-devnet.note: Deployed to local Midnight devnet (mn-demo-devnet). For Preview/Preprod deployment, fund the wallet from the faucet and run: npm run deploy:preview or npm run deploy:preprod

preview.note: Faucet outage at time of submission. Local devnet deployment is the verified deployment for Level 1 submission.

preprod.note: Faucet outage at time of submission. Local devnet deployment is the verified deployment for Level 1 submission.
